_comment: The document corpora: the places this project's written knowledge lives. The decisions are NOT here — they are records with their own contract (config/docs/adr-corpus.json: frontmatter, statuses, staleness), and one file with two kinds of rule is a file whose reader has to know which kind it is reading. This one declares the documents: the roots of every scope a search can see, how deep it walks, and what it reads. JSON rather than YAML because Python reads it with the standard library and Kotlin with kotlinx.serialization — the same two readers that read the ADR policy, and for the same reason: a policy only one side can read is a policy the other side ignores.
_comment_depth: How many directory levels below a root are walked. A corpus is a fixed set of directories, so the bound is a guard against an accidental symlink loop rather than a shape of the data.
_comment_extension: What a document is. Markdown, because every corpus here is markdown; a scope that needed another format would need its own rule rather than a global one.
